why: The first run (code 348aafd) compared the fixed-flux designs by pumping power per channel, as the set-up (11ea591) specified. Under a fixed first-wall flux a channel's duty grows with its wall width 2a, so that cost rewards a narrow channel for taking less heat, which only moves the heat to more channels. The rerun compares them per metre of first wall, pumping power / (2a). These are the first run's fixed-flux records, kept for the record; its fixed-duty records were unchanged by the correction and are not repeated here.

meta.note: The stages ran on the working tree that duct_opt_sha records, except the size of the compiled-film cache (ductopt.thermal._compiled_film): 48 for reduction and landscape, 16 for the optimum stages, 8 after. The cache holds compiled programs only and changes no number.
